64-719-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
64-719-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3605-4089-4808-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying {2}{U}, causing it to enter with additional Shapeshifter Rogue types as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

648-5879-6566.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is equal to or greater than the largest deck size among your opponents minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive.
648-5879-6566.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to leave the battlefield.
648-5879-6566.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cause the Fractal to leave the battlefield by any method.
Yuna triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters onto Walking Archive equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Fractal.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, they will draw cards equal to the number of counters on Walking Archive. This should result in them drawing from an empty library either during their upkeep or their subsequent draw step, losing the game.

225-2557-4094-6441-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-2557-4094-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

654-1308-4772-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2557-4772-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

132-7500-7826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Foods.

4289-4460-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4289-4460-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4289-4460-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1367-2963-7417.description:
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Blink Sanar using Teleportation Circle. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
1367-2963-7417.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

1621-3817-4605.description:
Cast Sister Hospitaller by paying its mana cost.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Wispweaver Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 3.

549-3259-5953-7060.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
549-3259-5953-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-3259-5953-7060.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2653-5478-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2653-5478-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer token enters, it triggers, creating a Mutavault land token that enters untapped due to Spelunking.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Mutavault token by tapping it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-2292-5010-5708.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

3661-5220-5256-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1084-3108-3668.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Flesh Duplicate.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Flesh Duplicate by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1995-3053-3918.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four basic land types among lands you control
1995-3053-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {3}{W}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}{W}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2541-6428-6824.notablePrerequisites:
Magmakin Artillerist has lifelink.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
2541-6428-6824.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1084-1491-4050-6667.description:
Acitvate Loporrit Scout by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Loporrit Scout triggers, giving Loporrit Scout +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Loporrit Scout ability from step 1, untapping it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

224-573-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping PuPu UFO.
Repeat.

1308-2457-4289-4359.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Equipment That Gives Haste to a Creature

1170-1171--78.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for the Equipment's equip ability if the Equipment is not already attached to Garth One-Eye.
1170-1171--78.description:
Activate the Equipment's equip ability by paying its equip cost, attaching it to Garth One-Eye.
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Repeat.
1170-1171--78.notes: Only Equipment whose equip cost costs three or less mana and that do not give shroud will function with this combo. If the Equipment costs two or less, this combo nets infinite colored mana, and you may instead cast any other cards permitted by Garth One-Eye except Shivan Dragon.

2292-4275-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a Human creature token, a Shaman creature token, and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
2292-4275-5470.description:
Create a creature token that is a Human and/or Shaman, and/or has changeling.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token created in step 2.
When the creature token dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures that share a creature type with it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 2.

4210-5544-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
4210-5544-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple triggers, targeting an opponent.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pious Evangel // Wayward Disciple ability, causing you to gain 1 life and causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1418-1558-4231-4428-4979.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Gilded Goose.
When Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

719-1424-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Coercive Recruiter.
Coercive Recruiter does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1424-2534.description:
Activate Coercive Recruiter by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Xenograft, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.

147-1379-2004-5256.description:
Cast Open the Vaults by paying {4}{W}{W}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Open the Vaults.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing any player to mill two cards.
Resolve a copy of Open the Vaults, returning all nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

466-2835-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have one or more cards in hand.
466-2835-4050.description:
Activate Saproling Cluster by discarding a card and paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Saproling token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Sparoling token, adding {1}.
Fecundity triggers, drawing you a card.
Repeat.

730-1479-3756.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-1479-3756.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Emeria Angel, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Emeria Angel trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
